content: Ta ishatoo! Isra7eele nayta gishshas ta amoynne ta Xoos woossizay istti dhayontta attanaassa.
Istti Xoossa yo7os mishettizayta gididayssa ta istta gishshas markkattana dandayays; istta misheteththi gidikko erateththan gidenna.
Xoossi as xillisiza oge erontta aggidi ba xilloteththa oge kaallida attiin Xoossa xilloteththa oge kaallibeettenna.
Ammaniza asaa ubbaa xillisanaas Kirstoosi woga ubbaa polides.
Musey woga baggara beettiza xilloteththaa gishshas erisishe, «Hayta wogata poli ooththizaadey ha wogatan daana» gizayssa.
Ammanon beettiza xilloteththi qasse, «Ne wozinara pude salo oonee kezanay? gooppa;» hessaththo guussi Kirstoosa saloppe duge haa woththana guussa.
Woykko, « ‹Duge ciimman oonee wodhdhanay?› Gooppa!» hessika Kirstoosa hayqoppe buro denththana guussa.
Gido attiin qaalay ay gizee? «Qaalay ne achchan dees.» Ne doonaninne ne wozinan dees, nuni ammano gishshas sabbakiza qaalay hayssa.
Neni ne doonara, «Yesusi Godaa» gaada markkattiko Xoossi iza hayqoppe denththidayssa ne wozinan ne ammanikko attana.
Neni xillanay wozinan ammanikko; ne attanay ne doonara markkattiina.
Geeshsha Maxaafay giza mala, «Izan ammanizay wurikka yeellatenna.»
Ayhudata giddoninne Ayzaabeta giddon dummateththi deenna; issi Goday ubbaasikka Godaa; iza woossizayta gujji anjjees.
«Godaa sunth xeygizayti wurikka attana» geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettides.
Histtiin iza ammanonttayti iza wozgi xeyganee? Qasse iza gishshas siyontta dishe wostti ammananee? Sabaakey baynda dishin wostti siyanee?
Kiitettontta wostti sabbakandettoo? Hessika, «Mishiraachcho qaala ekki yizayta yuussi ay mala lo7oo!» geetetti Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala hanides.
Gido attiin siyidayti wurikka Mishiraachcho qaalaa ekkibeettenna; Isayaasi, «Godoo! Nu yootidayssa ooni ammanidee?» gida mala hanides.
Hessa gishshas ammanoy beettizay yootiza qaala siyeththana; yootettiza qaalaykka Kirstoosa gishshas yootiza qaalaappe.
Gido attiin asay siyibeenneeshaa? gaada ta oychchays; tumappe asay siyides; Geeshsha Maxaafan xaafettida mala,
Ta qasseka oychchays; Isra7eele nayti qaalaa eribeetteneeshaa? Koyro Musey isttas,
Isayaasikka xalateththan,
Isra7eele gishshas qasse,
